definitions: A long, unbranched polysaccharide consisting of repeating disaccharide units, one of which is an amino sugar. They are highly polar and attract water, making them useful as a lubricant or shock absorber.
examples: Glycosaminoglycan is a key component of connective tissue.
The synthesis of glycosaminoglycan is a complex process.
Many biological functions depend on glycosaminoglycan interactions.
